name: Sennai ni Nazo no Seimei Hannou Ari!
original_name: 船内に謎の生命反応アリ!
source:
In an age where humanity can freely travel,
explore and perform commerce across the galaxy...
There was a hunter flying around the cosmos performing tasks.
One day, on a mission, her ship is infiltrated by unidentified creatures
and the busty hunter girl is in danger of...!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE202716.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在人类可以自由旅行、探索银河并进行贸易的时代……

有一名猎人在宇宙中飞行，执行各种任务。

某天执行任务时，她的飞船被不明生物侵入，这名身材丰满的猎人女孩将面临……！？

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE202716.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
